intro: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.
description:
Build a peaceful farm by day and defend everything you have created when night falls!

Farming and tower defense come together in a charming strategy experience. Plant crops, feed your animals, collect coins and expand your homestead with new structures. Every decision matters, so carefully plan where to place your crop fields, animal pens, storage buildings, defensive walls and barracks.

Your farm animals are more than just friendly residents—they can also become brave defenders! Recruit chickens, pigs, cows and goats, each offering different levels of speed, health and attack power. Position your animal army, strengthen vulnerable areas and prepare for the next enemy invasion.

Different crops are needed to care for different animals. Grow sunflowers for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep, and carrots for pigs and goats. Place structures close together to unlock useful bonuses, improve harvests, reduce feeding requirements and lower the cost of recruiting defenders.

As the seasons change, new dangers arrive. Wolves hunt your animals during spring, raccoons target valuable resources in summer, boars smash through defenses in fall and powerful bears attack your buildings in winter. Construct hay bales, wooden fences and stone barriers to slow them down before they reach the heart of your farm.

Balance expansion with preparation, improve your farm’s layout and survive through every season. A beautiful homestead can quickly become a battlefield, so grow wisely, build carefully and keep your animal defenders ready.

Can your cozy little farm survive an entire year?
